cards.measurable_observable: Forward 10-bar (4H) return of volume-confirmed breakouts vs unconfirmed breakouts, net of 25 bps.
cards.bar_definition: 4H bars, America/New_York, 09:30 anchor; decision at bar close; fill at next bar open.
cards.entry_exit_rules: Entry: completed 4H bar closes above the prior 20-bar high AND bar volume >= 1.5x the trailing 20-bar median volume. Exit: frozen exit stack.
cards.null_control_comparator: Identical breakouts WITHOUT the volume condition.
cards.preregistered_falsification_test: If volume-confirmed entries do not beat the unconfirmed null by at least +0.10R at 25 bps, falsified.
